title: Rabbi Acha bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3, speaking in the name of Rabbi Chiyya of Tzippori. The saying is repeated in Taanit 2:2, there in the name of Rabbi Chunah the Great of Tzippori. In Shabbat 3:4 he bathed with Rabbi Ba bar Mamal. He is mentioned in Yoma 4:4 concerning a lost item. In Shabbat 6:2 and Yevamot 12:2, Rabbi Acha bar Yitzchak sent a question to Rabbi Zeira, and Rabbi Zeira asked Rabbi Ami.
